register.labelZh: WEAR 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: wear away、wear down 和 wear out 能幫助你分辨某事物是逐漸消失、變薄,還是已經損壞至不能再用。；wear away 可以表示一段時間逐漸接近結束;wear on 則可以表示時間或事情繼續下去,通常顯得較慢。；當藥效、興奮、恐懼、驚訝或其他感覺逐漸消失時,可以使用 wear off。；wear somebody down 表示某人長時間受到影響而逐漸疲弱;wear somebody out 則表示令某人筋疲力盡。；wear something in 可以表示新鞋或衣物經過穿着後,變得較柔軟和舒服。
register.summaryEn: Wear away, wear down and wear out help you distinguish between something disappearing, becoming thinner and becoming completely unusable. Wear away can show that a period is moving towards its end, while wear on can show that time or an event continues, often slowly. Wear off is useful when medicine, excitement, fear, surprise or another feeling slowly disappears. Wear somebody down describes slow weakening over time. Wear somebody out describes making someone extremely tired. Wear something in lets you explain that new shoes or clothes have become softer and more comfortable through use.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. When using it, him, her, them or yourself, place the word as shown: wear it away wear him down wear them in wear it out wear yourself out Wear away and wear on can both be used with time, but they have slightly different focuses: The day was wearing away. The day was slowly moving towards its end. As the evening wore on, everyone became tired. The evening continued, and time seemed to pass slowly.
